review_candidates.title: Office Administrator
review_candidates.description: Company Description Remax Professional provides comprehensive real estate services for residential and commercial properties in Alexandria. The company focuses on effective property marketing and personalized support through experienced real estate consultants. Remax Professional aims to deliver a smooth and informed experience for clients throughout the buying, selling, and renting process. Team members work in a dynamic real estate environment with opportunities to contribute to local market growth and client satisfaction. Role Description The Office Admin role at Remax Professional is a full-time, on-site position based in Alexandria. The Office Admin is responsible for managing daily office operations, including answering calls, greeting visitors, organizing documents, and maintaining office supplies. This role supports real estate consultants by preparing property files, updating listings, coordinating appointments, and tracking key deadlines. The Office Admin will assist with basic data entry, record-keeping, and financial documentation, while ensuring accurate and timely information is available for the team. The position also includes responding to client inquiries, coordinating meetings, and helping maintain a professional and welcoming office environment. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in any field. Strong Office Administration and Administrative Assistance skills. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to multitask and handle different administrative tasks efficiently. Proficiency in common office software (e.g., MS Office or Google Workspace) and basic data entry. Candidates should be highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple tasks and deadlines. Candidates should be comfortable working on-site in a client-facing environment and collaborating with real estate consultants. Location Alexandria, Egypt
review_candidates.verification: Exact LinkedIn jobs-guest jobPosting endpoint returned a job detail page during this run
review_candidates.review_policy: Always pass exact-detail candidate to ChatGPT; closed status, weak keyword evidence, noisy title, or freshness conflict are annotations only
